facts: Complications is a set of essays by Atul Gawande about medicine as an imperfect science, written during his general surgery residency at Brigham and Women's Hospital.
He worked about 110 hours a week and wrote at night and on weekends (secondary source).
The first essay, 'Education of a Knife', describes his difficulty inserting a central venous catheter.
It also recounts an emergency tracheotomy that nearly killed a patient.
The essay raises the ethics of surgeons learning on patients: every surgeon was once a beginner, and the patient bears the risk.
The book shows a profession that presents itself as flawless while its practitioners work with uncertainty and error.
The tension: a trainee needs hard cases to gain experience, while the patient is better served by a more rested, more experienced hand.

In 'The Case of the Red Leg' (Part 3, Uncertainty) a doctor must tell common cellulitis from rare, deadly necrotizing fasciitis; influenced by a recent case of the latter, Gawande chose to perform a biopsy (secondary source).
scene_details: a central line that will not go in
an emergency tracheotomy that nearly killed a patient
essays written at night and on weekends after a long week
tension: Learning requires real patients, and the patient pays for the learner's inexperience and fatigue.
opening_idea: Open on Gawande writing essays at night after a week of about 110 hours.

lessons.idea: Decide in advance when you will ask for help, because tiredness weakens your ability to judge how impaired you are.

reflect_final: What is one situation in your own work where you would want a clear rule, set in advance, for when you hand something to someone fresher?

use_cases.situation: You are exhausted before an important task.
use_cases.move: Ask a rested colleague to double-check one step.

use_cases.situation: A family member insists on driving while exhausted.
use_cases.move: Offer to drive the first leg.

use_cases.situation: You are tempted to push through a late shift.
use_cases.move: Set a stop time before you start and tell someone.

pocket_idea: Gawande's residency weeks: the hand that wants the experience may be the one least able to judge its own fatigue.
